exports.name: decoded_length
exports.signature: pub fn decoded_length(input: &[u8], content: Span32) -> Result<StringLengths>
exports.behavior: Validates caller-provided content spans and measures decoded UTF-8 bytes and Unicode scalars without retaining output. Shares the public escape decoder and scanner discovery primitive, validates bounded raw UTF-8 runs, and preserves unescape counts, error metadata, and first-error precedence. Escape lookahead ends at the content boundary.

exports.name: utf8_length
exports.behavior: Measures actual UTF-8 byte length and chars().count() directly. Accepts all valid str contents without JSON syntax restrictions or normalization. Rejects oversized text with PayloadTooLarge, source Decode, at u32::MAX before traversing scalars.

coverage: Empty, ASCII, multibyte UTF-8, combining marks, regional indicators, variation selectors, joined emoji, BOM, and U+10FFFF with explicit byte and scalar counts
Plain UTF-8 measurement accepts controls, quotes, and backslashes while decoded JSON content rejects their raw forms
All eight simple escape spellings with one decoded byte and scalar each
Mixed-case Unicode hex and every UTF-8 scalar-width boundary, including NUL, U+D7FF, U+E000, U+FFFF, U+10000, and U+10FFFF
All 65536 BMP code units, with isolated surrogate units rejected
Every high surrogate paired with both low-surrogate endpoints, and every low surrogate paired with both high-surrogate endpoints
Mixed raw and escaped content, embedded NUL, escaped backslashes, combining sequences, and exact decoded counts independent of source spelling
Raw runs of zero through 128 bytes at starting offsets zero through 16, ending with an escaped Euro sign and an excluded quote
Empty spans at all short offsets, nonzero offsets, invalid surrounding bytes, span arithmetic overflow, and out-of-bounds spans
Every partial surrogate-pair boundary, truncated simple and Unicode escapes, and absolute EOF positions with completing bytes outside the span
UTF-8 sequences split at either span boundary for two-, three-, and four-byte scalars
All 256 raw byte values and all invalid escape-letter byte values
Malformed UTF-8 continuation bytes, overlong encodings, truncated sequences, encoded surrogates, invalid lead bytes, and values beyond U+10FFFF
Invalid hex at every digit position in both surrogate units, including an invalid digit immediately before bounded EOF
Missing surrogate partners, incomplete or wrong adjacent prefixes, and complete second units outside the low-surrogate range
First-error precedence after decoded prefixes and exact equality with unescape error metadata
All 729 three-byte inputs over a fixed nine-byte alphabet, measured across all ten valid subspans and compared with unescape
Wave 1 scanner integration, excluded wrapper quotes, and strict rejection of invalid escapes accepted by discovery
Synthetic text-size boundaries at u32::MAX and above where usize permits, without large allocation
Synthetic byte and scalar counter overflow, exact-limit success for each scalar width, atomic counter updates, and source-offset preservation
